statements.statement: A Finance Committee member said unallocated or excess funds rolling to free cash from FY2021 could fund streetlights, and he favours putting all of it in stabilization.

warnings.prediction: State costs will rise and state funding will fall, so the town should keep spending in reserve.
Teachers may have to be laid off because of state-level budget problems.
